articles.title_en: Endogenous Political Legitimacy: The Tudor Roots of England’s Constitutional Governance
articles.title_cn: 内生政治合法性：英格兰宪政体制的都铎根源
articles.abstract_en: This paper highlights the importance of endogenous changes in the foundations of legitimacy for political regimes. It focuses on the central role of legitimacy changes in the rise of constitutional monarchy in England. It first defines legitimacy and briefly elaborates a theoretical framework enabling a historical study of this unobservable variable. It proceeds to substantiate that the low-legitimacy, post-Reformation Tudor monarchs promoted Parliament to enhance their legitimacy, thereby changing the legislative process from the “crown and Parliament” to the “crown in Parliament” that still prevails in England. The break with Rome permanently altered England’s political development.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文强调了政治体制合法性基础的内生变化的重要性。它聚焦于英格兰宪政君主制兴起中合法性变化的中心作用。文章首先定义了合法性，并简要阐述了一个理论框架，以便对这一不可观测变量进行历史研究。接着，文章证实，低合法性的、宗教改革后的都铎君主为了提升自身合法性而提升了议会的地位，从而将立法过程从“国王与议会”转变为“国王在议会中”，这一模式至今仍在英格兰盛行。与罗马的决裂永久性地改变了英格兰的政治发展。

articles.title_en: State Formation and Bureaucratization: Evidence from Pre-Imperial China
articles.title_cn: 国家形成与官僚化：来自帝制前中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the relationship between military conflicts and state-building in pre-imperial China. I develop an incomplete contract model to examine rulers’ and local administrators’ incentives in conflict. Defensive wars drive decentralization: landowning local administrators have more to gain from a successful defense and are therefore more committed to it. Offensive wars drive centralization: the landowning ruler has personnel control over the non-land-owning local administrator and can therefore force the latter to participate in less lucrative attacks. Model predictions are corroborated with empirical evidence and historical case studies, and offer broader implications for the political divergence between China and Europe.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了帝制前中国军事冲突与国家建设之间的关系。我构建了一个不完全契约模型，以考察统治者和地方行政官员在冲突中的激励。防御性战争推动分权：拥有土地的地方行政官员从成功防御中获益更多，因此更致力于防御。进攻性战争推动集权：拥有土地的统治者对不拥有土地的地方行政官员拥有人事控制权，因此可以强制后者参与收益较低的进攻。模型预测得到了实证证据和历史案例研究的佐证，并为中国与欧洲之间的政治分化提供了更广泛的启示。

articles.title_en: Internal Migration in the United States: Rates, Selection, and Destination Choice, 1850–1940
articles.title_cn: 美国国内移民：比率、选择与目的地选择，1850-1940
articles.abstract_en: I study native-born white men’s internal migration in the United States over all possible 10- and 20-year periods between 1850 and 1940. Inter-county migration rates—after implementing a new method to correct for errors in linkage—were stable over time. Migrant selection on the basis of occupational status was neutral or slightly negative and also largely stable. But the orientation of internal migration changed over time, declining in distance and increasingly driving urbanization. In the 1930s, migration became less common and less urban oriented. These results provide a clearer understanding of historic U.S. internal migration than previously possible.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了1850年至1940年间所有可能的10年和20年期间美国本土出生的白人男性的国内移民。在采用一种新方法纠正链接错误后，县际移民比率随时间保持稳定。基于职业地位的移民选择是中性的或略微负面的，并且也基本稳定。但国内移民的方向随时间发生了变化，距离缩短，且日益推动城市化。在1930年，移民变得不那么普遍，且城市化导向减弱。这些结果提供了对历史上美国国内移民比以往更清晰的理解。

articles.title_en: The Belle-Epoque of Portfolios? How Returns, Risk, and Diversification Correlated with the Wealth Distribution in Paris in 1912
articles.title_cn: 投资组合的美好时代？1912年巴黎的收益、风险与分散化如何与财富分布相关
articles.abstract_en: I reconstruct the historical performance of individual portfolios owned by Parisian investors during the French Belle-Epoque , which was characterized by a massive concentration of wealth. Using the value of inherited bequests as a proxy for ex ante wealth, I show that wealthier investors not only exhibited greater betas and thus benefited from the bull market, but also captured positive alphas, which translated into greater Sharpe ratios. Their performance was enhanced by diversification tilted toward equity and foreign assets. I identify heterogeneity in returns as a significant driver of the rise of wealth inequalities during the Belle-Epoque .
articles.abstract_cn: 我重建了法国美好时代期间巴黎投资者所拥有的个人投资组合的历史表现，这一时期的特点是财富的高度集中。以继承遗产的价值作为事前财富的代理指标，我表明较富有的投资者不仅表现出更高的贝塔值，从而受益于牛市，而且还获得了正的阿尔法值，这转化为更高的夏普比率。他们的表现通过偏向股票和外国资产的分散化得到了增强。我识别出收益的异质性作为美好时代财富不平等加剧的重要驱动因素。

articles.title_en: Reform, Rails, and Rice: Political Railroads and Local Development in Thailand
articles.title_cn: 改革、铁路与大米：泰国的政治铁路与地方发展
articles.abstract_en: How do external threats to state sovereignty benefit local development? In this paper, we look at Thailand’s railroad projects in the late-nineteenth and early-twentieth centuries as an example of a state’s strategic response to colonial encroachment. By transporting government officials and establishing a permanent administrative presence, the railways served to ensure Thailand’s sovereignty over peripheral regions and bring them under direct governance. These regions, long considered economically unviable and disconnected from Bangkok, gained rail access due to their strategic importance and, in turn, witnessed urbanization and increased agricultural production.
articles.abstract_cn: 外部对国家主权的威胁如何惠及地方发展？在本文中，我们将泰国在十九世纪末和二十世纪初的铁路项目视为国家对殖民侵蚀的战略回应。通过运送政府官员并建立永久的行政存在，铁路旨在确保泰国对边缘地区的主权，并将其置于直接治理之下。这些地区长期被认为经济上不可行且与曼谷脱节，因其战略重要性而获得了铁路接入，并因此见证了城市化和农业生产的增加。

articles.title_en: Ora et Guberna. The Economic Impact of the Rule of St Benedict in Medieval England
articles.title_cn: 祈祷与治理：中世纪英格兰圣本笃修会规的经济影响
articles.abstract_en: Within the turmoil of the Norman Conquest, did religious institutions affect the economic outcomes of their land? Exploiting historical data about the changes in holdings’ lordship that occurred after the Conquest, we compare the economic performance of estates controlled by different types of lords. Holdings controlled by Benedictine monasteries (vis-à-vis secular lords) experienced a better performance, although, once accounting for the unchanging upper level of the feudal structure, we cannot fully disentangle this effect from the persistence of Benedictine Overlordship. A comparison with Celtic monasteries, with a different organizational structure, suggests a role for the governance structure of Benedictine monasteries.
articles.abstract_cn: 在诺曼征服的动荡中，宗教机构是否影响了其土地的经济成果？利用关于征服后领地领主变更的历史数据，我们比较了由不同类型领主控制的庄园的经济表现。由本笃会修道院控制的领地（相对于世俗领主）表现更好，尽管在考虑封建结构中不变的上层后，我们无法完全将这一效应与本笃会最高领主权的持续性区分开来。与组织结构不同的凯尔特修道院进行比较，表明本笃会修道院的治理结构发挥了作用。

articles.title_en: The Great Depression as a Savings Glut
articles.abstract_en: New data covering 23 countries reveal that banking crises of the Great Depression coincided with a sharp international increase in deposits at savings institutions and life insurance. Deposits fled from commercial banks to alternative forms of savings. This fueled a credit crunch since other institutions did not replace bank lending. While asset prices fell, savings held in savings institutions and life insurance companies increased as a share of GDP and in real terms. These findings provide new explanations for the fall in credit and aggregate demand in the 1930s. They illustrate the need to consider nonbank financial institutions when studying banking crises.
articles.abstract_cn: 覆盖23个国家的新数据显示，大萧条时期的银行业危机与国际上储蓄机构和人寿保险存款的急剧增加同时发生。存款从商业银行流向其他形式的储蓄。这加剧了信贷紧缩，因为其他机构并未替代银行贷款。尽管资产价格下跌，储蓄机构和保险公司持有的储蓄占GDP的比重以及实际值均有所增加。这些发现为1930年代信贷和总需求的下降提供了新的解释。它们表明在研究银行业危机时需要考虑非银行金融机构。

articles.title_en: Zombie International Currency: The Pound Sterling 1945–1971
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the international role of sterling during the Bretton Woods era and argues that it was not a competitor to the U.S. dollar. I construct a novel dataset to measure the reserve role of sterling in Europe and sterling area countries. The postwar reserve role of sterling was limited to the sterling area and was artificial as this area was built as a captive market. I document how British authorities imposed exchange controls, commercial threats, and economic sanctions on sterling area countries to compel them to keep their foreign exchange reserves in sterling.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了布雷顿森林体系时期英镑的国际角色，并认为它并非美元的竞争对手。我构建了一个新颖的数据集来衡量英镑在欧洲和英镑区国家的储备角色。战后英镑的储备角色仅限于英镑区，并且是人为的，因为该地区被构建为一个受控市场。我记录了英国当局如何对英镑区国家施加外汇管制、商业威胁和经济制裁，以迫使它们将外汇储备保留在英镑中。
